name: Inventory Replenishment Calculator
summary: Calculates safety stock and the reorder point for an item from demand, its variability, lead time and a target service level.
description: Calculates daily demand, demand during lead time, safety stock and the reorder point for one item, using the cycle service level method with the service level you choose. Demand and lead time can be given per day, week or month; both are converted to days before anything is combined, and the conversion is shown. With current stock it also reports days of cover and whether to reorder now. Who it's for: operations, inventory and e-commerce managers setting reorder points. Limitations: assumes roughly normal, independent daily demand and independent lead times; it does not optimise order quantity or handle seasonality, and a month is taken as 30.4375 days.
problems: When should we reorder this item
How much safety stock do we need
Calculate a reorder point from lead time and demand

inputs.label: Average demand
inputs.description: Average units sold or used per demand period.

inputs.label: Demand standard deviation
inputs.description: How much demand varies per demand period (standard deviation, same unit).

inputs.label: Demand period
inputs.description: The period the demand figures are per.

inputs.label: Lead time
inputs.description: Time from placing an order to receiving it.

inputs.label: Lead time standard deviation
inputs.description: How much lead time varies, in the lead time unit.

inputs.label: Service level
inputs.description: Share of order cycles without a stock-out.

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered inventory_reorder@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain the reorder point and safety stock in plain terms, how the service level and variability drive them, and whether to reorder now. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
